spans.s: गौरमुख m. N. of sev. men.
गौरमृग॑ m. a kind of buffalo (Bos Gaurus).

गौरसर्षप m. yellow mustard or the seed of it
(considered as a weight).
गौरीगुरु m. the father of Gaurī, i.e. the Himālaya.
गौरीनाथ m. the husband of Gaurī, i.e. Śiva.
गौरीपति m. the husband of Gaurī, i.e. Śiva.
गौरीपूजा f. the adoration of Gaurī, a cert. festival.
गौरीभर्तृ m. the lord of Gaurī, i.e. Śiva.
गौरीश m. the lord of Gaurī, i.e. Śiva.
गौरीव्रत n. the vow of Gauri (a kind of rite).
